items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: Sidney Spies and, uh, only a five-piece band. And I was playing piano.

ctx.x: No. Maybe so. All probability, yeah. Could be. And, uh, Sidney Spies was on trumpet. Sidney was on, this was on, we were all union players, I think in those days. Yeah. Yeah. We were union then. And, uh, Sidney Spies was a trumpet player. He worked, I remember he worked out at the music box when I was there. It was a dance hall down on Canal and, Canal and Cronlette on the second floor. Diamond Dance deal. We had three piano players in there. We mentioned that the last time.
Yeah, we did, but we didn't get the rest of the band, so it kept going.
